content_text:
Hi,
I’m trying to remember the details about the origins of a film director, where I remember the story being that he worked long days as a dishwasher and filmed at night? Or maybe it was that he filmed on the weekend with a borrowed camera? And where while he was doing the mindless task of washing dishes – that was where his mind was allowed to wander and he came up with all his ideas. Does any of this ring a bell for anyone? Do you perhaps remember which episode they spoke about this in? I think it was in the first or second season. I don’t think the episode was an interview with this director, but this was just an anecdote within the conversation. I’m interested in listening to the whole episode again.
Thank you!
